tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and the sign-in form. ink, muted and accent all read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: nav-bg
tokens.usage: The side menu, sign-in brand panel and toast. Deep teal in light, near-black teal in dark.

tokens.name: nav-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on nav-bg and nav-active (9.9:1 light). Only on the nav surfaces.

tokens.name: nav-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on nav-bg: the user role under the name, sign-in taglines.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: The scanner rings drawn on nav-bg and the sample-data chip. Never a text color.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: A paper document (bill, report, prescription) in the review workspace. Stays light in both themes, as paper does.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text and the heading rule on paper. Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-line
tokens.usage: Paper border and dashed row dividers on paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, tables, dialog and the active nav item. The main reading surface.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover rows, disabled inputs, empty split bar and donut track, secondary-button hover.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, surface and surface-2 (14:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, KPI labels, dates. On bg, surface and surface-2 (5.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card heads, table rows, dialog border, topbar edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary and danger buttons, the dashed upload box. 2.98:1 on surface in light, a hair under the 3:1 control-border floor; kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, the active nav label, secondary-button text. As text on surface and bg (6.5:1+).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill: the primary button label. White in light, dark teal in dark (the dark accent is light).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted grounds: the info chip, the view-as banner, table totals row, avatar.

tokens.name: accent-soft-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft (8.8:1 light, 9.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: The one large money figure block on the finance pages.

tokens.name: hero-ink
tokens.usage: Text on hero.

tokens.name: hero-line
tokens.usage: The rule under the hero figure.

tokens.name: viewer
tokens.usage: The study pictures and scanner frame: a near-black field for medical images.

tokens.name: viewer-ink
tokens.usage: Text and overlays on viewer.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Success chip and notice ground: approved, matched, all clear.

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ok-bg (7:1+). Always paired with a word, never color alone.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Warning ground: waiting on the patient, needs review, the nav badge, sample-mode bar.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warn-bg (7.9:1+).

tokens.name: bad-bg
tokens.usage: Error ground: returned case, rejected ZIP, failed load.

tokens.name: bad-ink
tokens.usage: Text on bad-bg, field errors on surface, danger-button label, invalid input border.

tokens.name: neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral chip ground: duplicate, system events.

tokens.name: neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Text on neutral-bg; also table header text on surface.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Donut slot 1. Each slot keeps one meaning across charts; the legend always names it.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Donut slot 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Donut slot 3. 2.8:1 on surface in light, under the 3:1 mark floor; the legend carries the meaning.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Donut slot 4. 2.2:1 on surface in light, under the 3:1 mark floor; the legend carries the meaning.

tokens.name: scan
tokens.usage: The scanner: sweep line, corner brackets, selected DICOM thumbnail, slider accent. Only on viewer.

tokens.name: share-hospital
tokens.usage: The hospital share in the fee split bar and its legend swatch.

tokens.name: share-insurance
tokens.usage: The insurance share in the fee split bar and its legend swatch. Low against surface-2 in light (2.3:1); the bar carries an aria-label and a labelled legend.

tokens.name: share-management
tokens.usage: The management share in the fee split bar and its legend swatch. Low against surface-2 (1.6:1 light); the labelled legend carries the meaning.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus outline: 3px solid, 2px offset, on every focusable element. 2.7:1 on surface in light, under the 3:1 floor; kept as the source has it.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: h1: one page title per screen, with PageTitle.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The headline figures in the money band (ZIP count, fee total). Tabular numerals.

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: .kpi-value: a single figure in a KPI block. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: h3: a center or group name inside a card.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: پزشک نسخه، گزارش و تصاویر را باز می‌بیند و تصمیم می‌گیرد.
styles.usage: Body copy in every staff panel. Persian needs the generous 1.7 leading.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status chips and table headers (600); field hints and KPI labels use the same size at 400 or 500.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Brand subtitle, KPI sub-line, nav badge (at 700).

styles.name: patient-title
styles.usage: h1 inside .patient. One thing per screen.

styles.name: patient-body
styles.sample: عکس واضح از کل برگه بگیرید.
styles.usage: Base size for everything in the patient panel: larger type for phones and older readers.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: .ltr: Latin codes, IDs and usernames set left-to-right inside RTL text.

spacing.note: Spacing is written as Tailwind classes in the components; these are the recurring steps, named by value. Changing them here does not change the app.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between split-bar segments and crumb rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Label-to-input gap in a Field; nav item gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Chip dot to text; KPI label swatch gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The default gap: .row, .stack-s, button icon to label.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Brand mark to name; table cell block padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Notice and card-head block padding; skeleton gap.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Table cell inline padding; form grid gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: .stack gap, page gutter, notice inline padding.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Button inline padding; side menu padding and gap.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page top padding; toast offset from the bottom.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Sign-in brand panel padding.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards, notices, dialog, money band, skeleton blocks, every other surface.

tokens.name: radius-toast
tokens.usage: Toast and the patient full-width button.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: The small brand mark tile (34px). The large mark (52px) uses radius.

tokens.name: radius-split
tokens.usage: The 14px fee split bar: half its height.

tokens.name: radius-thumb
tokens.usage: Upload thumbnails and small inner tiles.

tokens.name: radius-swatch
tokens.usage: Legend swatches (10px squares).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, nav badge, sample chip.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The only elevation: cards, KPI blocks, money band, review head. Cards have no border once shadowed.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toast only.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The bottom bar and sheet on phones.

layout.note: Sizes that set the shape of every screen. All are CSS variables except collapse, which media queries write as 860px.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons, inputs, links and crumbs.

tokens.name: patient-target
tokens.usage: Patient primary button height; patient inputs are 58px.

tokens.name: side-menu
tokens.usage: Width of the side menu on wide screens.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: collapse
tokens.usage: Below this the side menu becomes a bottom bar and sign-in stacks.
